method: Reviewed full draft against Korea Energy Agency (KEA) winter heating guidance and Ministry of the Interior and Safety policy briefing pages. Verified heating tent interior temperature rise (3-5C), triple-weave blackout curtain effect (1-3C), indoor comfort ranges (18-20C, 40-60% humidity), 7% energy saving per 1C, monthly gas bill savings (30,000-50,000 KRW, 20-30% on a 150,000 KRW baseline), curtain hem allowance (5-10 cm), and condensation ventilation routine (10 min after waking). All numbers in the draft are covered by the research record.
